name: Counter-Strike 2
author: GrassNotFound
startup: ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 -dedicated -console $( [[ "${ENABLE_RCON}" == "1" ]] && echo -n "-usercon" ) $( [[ "${INSECURE}" == "1" ]] && echo -n "-insecure" ) -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +ip 0.0.0.0 -maxplayers_override {{MAX_PLAYERS}} $( [[ -z "${STEAM_ACC}" ]] || echo -n "+sv_setsteamaccount ${STEAM_ACC}" ) $( [[ -z "${WORKSHOP_AUTHKEY}" ]] || echo -n "-authkey ${WORKSHOP_AUTHKEY}" ) +game_type {{GAME_TYPE}} +game_mode {{GAME_MODE}} +hostname "{{HOSTNAME}}" +sv_password "{{SRV_PASSWORD}}" +rcon_password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" +sv_lan {{SV_LAN}} +sv_region {{SV_REGION}} +bot_quota {{BOT_QUOTA}} +sv_hibernate_when_empty {{HIBERNATE}} $( [[ "${TV_ENABLE}" == "1" ]] && echo -n "+tv_enable 1 +tv_port ${TV_PORT} +tv_delay ${TV_DELAY} +tv_maxclients ${TV_MAXCLIENTS} +tv_password ${TV_PASSWORD:-0}" || echo -n "-nohltv" ) $( [[ -z "${WORKSHOP_COLLECTION}" ]] || echo -n "+host_workshop_collection ${WORKSHOP_COLLECTION}" ) $( [[ -n "${WORKSHOP_MAP}" ]] && echo -n "+host_workshop_map ${WORKSHOP_MAP}" || echo -n "+mapgroup ${MAPGROUP} +map ${SRCDS_MAP}" ) $( [[ -z "${EXEC_CFG}" ]] || echo -n "+exec ${EXEC_CFG}" ) {{EXTRA_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
export HOME=/mnt/server
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

variables.name: Hostname
variables.description: Server name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: Steam Game Server Login Token (GSLT), created at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers with App ID 730. Required for a public, internet-visible server. Leave empty for LAN only.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console. Needed for the panel console to send commands. Leave empty to disable RCON.

variables.name: Enable RCON
variables.description: Adds -usercon so the server accepts RCON connections. Requires an RCON password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots (-maxplayers_override). Casual/Competitive normally use 10-16, Deathmatch up to 64.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: First half of the game mode pair. 0 Classic, 1 Gun Game, 2 Training, 3 Custom, 4 Cooperative, 5 Skirmish. Combine with Game Mode: 0/0 Casual, 0/1 Competitive, 0/2 Wingman, 0/3 Weapons Expert, 1/0 Arms Race, 1/1 Demolition, 1/2 Deathmatch, 4/0 Guardian, 4/1 Co-op Strike.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Second half of the game mode pair, see Game Type for the valid combinations.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map to start on. Ignored when a Workshop Map ID is set.

variables.name: Map Group
variables.description: Map rotation group from gamemodes_server.txt, e.g. mg_active. Ignored when a Workshop Map ID is set.

variables.name: Workshop Map ID
variables.description: Steam Workshop file ID to host instead of the map above (+host_workshop_map). Needs a Workshop API key.

variables.name: Workshop Collection ID
variables.description: Steam Workshop collection ID to use as map rotation (+host_workshop_collection). Needs a Workshop API key.

variables.name: Workshop API Key
variables.description: Steam Web API key from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, required for downloading workshop maps (-authkey).

variables.name: LAN Mode
variables.description: 1 makes the server LAN only: no Steam authentication, no GSLT needed, not visible on the internet.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Region shown in the server browser. 0 US East, 1 US West, 2 South America, 3 Europe, 4 Asia, 5 Australia, 6 Middle East, 7 Africa, 255 World.

variables.name: Bot Quota
variables.description: Number of bots the server fills up with. 0 disables bots.

variables.name: Hibernate When Empty
variables.description: 1 lets the server idle at low CPU usage while nobody is connected. Turn off if a plugin needs to keep running.

variables.name: Insecure (VAC off)
variables.description: Adds -insecure, disabling VAC. Needed for some plugin or debug setups, never for a public server.

variables.name: Enable GOTV
variables.description: Enables GOTV broadcasting. GOTV listens on its own port, so add a second allocation for it.

variables.name: GOTV Port
variables.description: Port GOTV listens on. Must be an allocation assigned to this server.

variables.name: GOTV Delay
variables.description: GOTV broadcast delay in seconds.

variables.name: GOTV Max Clients
variables.description: Maximum number of GOTV spectators.

variables.name: GOTV Password
variables.description: Password for GOTV spectators. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: Config to Execute
variables.description: Config file in game/csgo/cfg executed on start, e.g. server.cfg. Leave empty to skip.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra launch parameters or console variables appended verbatim, e.g. +mp_autoteambalance 0 +sv_cheats 0. Note: CS2 runs at a fixed subtick rate, -tickrate does nothing.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Steam app id used for install and auto updates.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server files on every boot.
